Read the passage carefilly and choose the best answer A.B, C or D.

Maya had always loved fashion. Ever since she was a little girl, she would spend hours flipping through
fashion magazines in her aunt's house. Her school holidays were spent sketching designs and cutting up
her mother's old clothes to create new looks. Growing up in a small town, she never imagined that one day
she would become a famous fashion designer.
After finishing college, Maya moved to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur to pursue her dream. She
started off by working as an assistant at a high-end fashion house. She quickly made a name for herself
with her talent and dedication. She was known for her bold colours and innovative designs. Finally, after
years of hard work, Maya launched her own fashion line, Serenity Designs. Maya's designs were a hit
among celebrities and fashion enthusiasts alike. Her unique style combined classic elegance with modern
trends, making her stand out in the highly competitive industry. She would spend hours in her studio,
sketching new designs and working with her team of skilled seamstresses to bring her creations to life. Her
team members greatly admired her diligence.
One day, Maya received a phone call that would change her life forever. It was from the organisers of
Paris Fashion Week, inviting her to showcase her collection on the prestigious runway. Maya was ecstatic.
This was a dream come true for her, and she wasted no time in preparing for the biggest moment of her
career. As the day of fashion show approached, Maya felt mix of excitement and nerves. She had put her
heart and soul into this collection, and she hoped that the audience would appreciate her hard work. On
the day of the show, Maya stood backstage, watching as the models walked down the runway, showcasing
her designs to the crowd of fashion elites.
After the show ended, Maya was surrounded by journalists and fashion critics, all eager to interview the
talented designer. As she answered their questions and posed for photographs, Maya felt sense of pride and
accomplishment. She had come a long way from the little girl sketching designs in her bedroom. As the
night came to an end, Maya was approached by a well-known fashion editor who congratulated her on a
successful show. 'I have been following your work for a while now, and I must say, your designs are truly
remarkable. You have a bright future ahead of you, Maya,' the editor said. Maya beamed with joy. Thank
you so much for your words. This means the world to me,' she replied, her eyes shining with gratitude.
With Paris Fashion Week behind her, Maya's career continued to soar. Her designs were featured in top
fashion magazines, and she received numerous awards for her innovative creations. Despite her success,
Maya remained humble and grounded, always grateful for the opportunities that had come her way.
Year passed, and Maya's fashion empire grew beyond her wildest dreams. She opened flagship stores
in major cities around the world and collaborated with top designers on exclusive collections. Despite her
busy schedule, Maya always made time to mentor young aspiring designers, eager to share her knowledge
and passion for fashion.
One day, as Maya sat in her studio sketching new designs, she received a surprise visitor. It was her
mentor, the renowned fashion designer, who had inspired her to pursue her dreams. 'Maya, 1 am so proud
of the designer you have become. Your talents and dedication have truly set you apart in this industry, her
mentor said, with a smile. Maya's eyes welled up with tears. "Thank you so much for believing in me. You
have been my inspiration since the beginning,' she replied, her voice filled with emotion.

As Maya looked back on her incredible journey, she realised that her success was not just about creating
beautiful clothes. It was about following her passion, staying true to herself and never giving up on her
dreams. She had come a long way from the small-town girl with big dreams, and she was grateful for every
moment of her incredible journey.

Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming part of our everyday lives. From search engines and
language apps to smart assistants, students often use Al to learn, create, and communicate.
However, with these opportunities comes the responsibility to use Al wisely and ethically.
First, students should remember that Al is a tool, not a replacement for human thinking. It
can provide quick answers, suggest ideas, or check grammar, but it cannot fully replace creativity,
critical thinking, or personal judgement.
Relying too much on Al may weaken
independent skills.
Second, responsible use involves honesty.
Instead, students should treat
Al as a support system, like a dictionary or calculator, rather than a shortcut. Teachers value
originality, so it is important to show personal effort and voice in assignments.
Third, students must be aware of bias and accuracy. Al systems learn from large amounts
of data, which may include mistakes or stereotypes.
(29) ______
Before accepting
information, students should cross-check with reliable sources. Developing a habit of questioning
Al responses helps build stronger critical thinking skills.
Privacy is another important aspect. Many Al tools collect data from users.
They should also read basic privacy settings before using new platforms. Protecting
one's digital identity is part of responsible online behaviour.
Finally, responsible Al use also means balance.
(31) ______
Discussing
ideas
with classmates, asking teachers for feedback, and practising problem-solving without digital help
are still essential for growth.
It is undeniable that Al is a powerful tool that can support education, but it must be used
with care.
Responsible use ensures that Al becomes a partner in learning, not a
shortcut that limits personal development.
In conclusion, Al is inevitable. Therefore, embracing the technology while still practising
cautious is advisable.

Teens on Financial Awareness
A - ADAM, 16 years old
T've started using a mobile app to track every ringgit I spend. It's eye-opening to see how
much goes toward snacks! By categorising my expenses, I can see exactly where 1 can cut
back to save for a new laptop. Being disciplined now means I won't have to borrow money
later.
B- BELLA, 15 years old
I'm a huge fan of thrift shopping and buying pre-loved clothes. Not only is it cheaper, but
it's also better for the planet. I rarely buy anything new unless it's a basic necessity. I feel
proud when I find a high-quality vintage jacket for a fraction of its original retail price.
C - CHLOE, 17 years old
My parents taught me the "30-day rule". If 1 see something 1 want, I have to wait a full
month before buying it. Most of the time, 1 realise I didn't actually need the item. This habit
has saved me from making many expensive mistakes and keeps my room clutter-free.
D - DANIEL, 16 years old
I've started a small business washing cars in my neighbourhood during the weekends.
Instead of just asking my parents for an allowance, I prefer earning my own cash. It makes
me value my belongings more because I know exactly how many hours of hard work it took
to afford them.
E - ETHAN, 17 years old
I am very focused on "comparison shopping." Before making any major purchase, I spend
hours reading reviews and checking different websites for the lowest price. I refuse to pay
more than I have to. For me, being a smart consumer means doing your homework before
tapping your card.
F -FARAH, 15 years old
Every month, the first thing 1 do with my pocket money is put 20% into a high-interest
savings account. I treat it like a bill that must be paid. My goal is to have a solid emergency
fund. It gives me a sense of security knowing I have a "rainy-day account" for unexpected
costs.
